mentions.name: Maiyo Institute
mentions.description: A research institute for East Africa addressing the region's dire lack of environmental data by combining low-cost hardware, artificial intelligence, and a long-term horizon. Its current focus is on low-cost sensors for air and water data collection plus bioacoustics.
mentions.problem: A dire lack of environmental data in East Africa.
mentions.audience: East African communities affected by the lack of environmental data
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a research institute for East Africa, https://maiyoinstitute.org/. I want to tackle the dire lack of environmental data, by using 1. low cost hardware 2. Artificial Intelligence 3. Long term horizon. The problem set is huge, but I am focusing on low cost sensors for Air and Water data collection plus bioacoustics for now.
